Venkov and Zograf's finite-index Fuchsian-group factorization \citep{P32-CW02};
Blute, Cockett, Jacqmin, and Scott's generalized power-series construction
\citep{P32-CW03}; and Parry and Pollicott's periodic-orbit zeta monograph
\citep{P32-CW04}. Their earlier owner-decision, cover-product, formal-support and
analytic-program assignments are provisional comparison labels, not verified
source contributions or an established ranking of closest work. The four retained
locator strings have no bound support excerpts or excerpt digests in the current
locked source-finalization rows, so their substantive support remains
\texttt{UNVERIFIABLE}. The comparison matrix
\path{notes/stage4_prime_closest_work_comparison_matrix_round2.json}
(SHA-256 \texttt{5ab85f5c\allowbreak{}c3e5d39c\allowbreak{}ede06b16\allowbreak{}3cf18945\allowbreak{}b1b4178b\allowbreak{}9f7d8182\allowbreak{}a9973b55\allowbreak{}074601e4})
is retained as a record of proposed roles only. Every source-specific role,
absence, overlap and ``closest'' label in the following table and its concluding paragraph is a candidate
comparison hypothesis awaiting original-passage verification, not an established
property of the cited work. Metadata supports none of those substantive properties
or negative-overlap claims. In particular, ``no verified overlap'' means no
passage-backed transfer is established here, not that the source lacks the stated
result; ``nearest'' and ``closest'' identify only provisional component assignments,
not a verified ranking. The concluding statement ``none closes the joint
dependency chain'' means only that this manuscript accepts no passage-backed
transfer of a completed chain from these records; it is not a finding that the
sources contain no such result. The concluding phrase ``source-verified passage
scope'' establishes no positive passage scope for P32-CW01--P32-CW04, whose
substantive support remains unverified. No passage-backed premise is transferred
from P32-CW01--P32-CW04.

The corpus and article also do not establish novelty. The output is
deliberately positioned as a bounded research-program study.

disavow statistically independent validation; they do not supply a complete
session/model activity ledger. Gate approval is not treated here as evidence of

conceptual, gate-approval or adjudication acts or supply a personal accountability
